body.name: tagged residual certificate-verification transition
body.construction:
The relation \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\) receives only \(\operatorname{Residual}(\mathrm{tag},\mathrm{payload})\) tasks produced by an explicit LGS failure or irreducible residual.  Its projection generator enumerates the circuits induced by every displayed finite elimination order. Its contrast generator enumerates the fixed signed canonical response-row swaps and finite tensor products, builds the rational observation-map matrix, and performs deterministic rational row reduction in encoded order to enumerate affine nullspace contrasts and rational sign boxes. It tests these generated candidates in canonical order; no desired formula, contrast, or successful trace is supplied.  A projection \(P/D\) passes only if every divisor occurs in the ledger and
\[
 D\,t_{a,H}^{N}-P(o_H^{N})=0
\]
after exact cross-multiplication modulo the retained constraints.  A pair of rational affine primitive-coordinate maps on a rational open box passes only if substitution gives identical observation polynomials, a nonzero target polynomial of constant certified sign, simplex membership, strictly positive admissible cells, and selector mass positive exactly on \(H\).  A passing projection emits \(\operatorname{Formula}(F_H,\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}},\mathfrak D_H)\); a passing contrast is reinserted by \(\rho_H\) and emits the global-twin certificate.  If no candidate passes, the result is \(\operatorname{ResidualPending}(\mathrm{tag},\mathrm{payload})\).  An LGS failure tag alone is never interpreted as a nonidentification certificate.
